affine_continuation_loss_init_8.label: Affine shape scaffolding
affine_continuation_loss_init_8.explanation: Blends raw prediction error with error after affine calibration, rewarding the right functional shape before its scale and offset are tuned.

symmetric_motif_duplication_gen4_9.label: Symmetric motif duplication
symmetric_motif_duplication_gen4_9.explanation: Copies an expression subtree, optionally remaps its input variables, and reuses it through binary coupling or grafting into a matching structure.

affine_angular_profile_loss_2pass_gen8_1.label: Sharper affine shape discrimination
affine_angular_profile_loss_2pass_gen8_1.explanation: Uses normalized affine residual RMSE with a stable second residual pass and a bounded raw-error term to better distinguish nearly correct shapes.

symmetric_motif_duplication_gen9_6.label: Simplified cyclic motif coupling
symmetric_motif_duplication_gen9_6.explanation: Restricts motif reuse to binary coupling and cyclic variable shifts, removing targeted substitutions, grafting, and the unary fallback.

crowding_suppressed_niche_tournament_gen.label: Clone suppression and niche rescue
crowding_suppressed_niche_tournament_gen.explanation: Enlarges the tournament, penalizes redundant candidates, mildly favors younger members, and occasionally selects from a rare complexity niche.

symmetric_motif_duplication_gen10_1_gen1.label: Size-aware targeted motif reuse
symmetric_motif_duplication_gen10_1_gen1.explanation: Adds size-budget checks, favors compound motifs containing variables, restores targeted variable substitutions, and biases coupling toward addition and multiplication.

crowding_suppressed_rare_niche_tournamen.label: Simplified rare-niche selection
crowding_suppressed_rare_niche_tournamen.explanation: Removes sibling penalties and the youth discount while retaining clone suppression and occasional selection from the rarest complexity niche.

novelty_weighted_quality_gated_niche_tou.label: Quality-gated niche exploration
novelty_weighted_quality_gated_niche_tou.explanation: Combines clone suppression with similarity-dependent sibling penalties and adaptive rare-niche exploration restricted to sufficiently good niche champions.

age_and_cost_regularized_survival_gen19_.label: Cost-aware age replacement
age_and_cost_regularized_survival_gen19_.explanation: Combines age and cost ranks with weights of 0.75 and 0.25, respectively, so older and worse candidates are more likely to be replaced.

motif_duplication_with_rational_coupling.label: Rational motif coupling
motif_duplication_with_rational_coupling.explanation: Combines the compact cyclic-shift and size-aware motif parents and adds rational couplings of the form target divided by one plus or minus a motif.

motif_duplication_simple_rational_gen27_.label: Simplified rational motif templates
motif_duplication_simple_rational_gen27_.explanation: Keeps cyclic or unchanged motifs with addition, multiplication, or target divided by one minus the motif, removing extra remapping and coupling branches.

age_and_cost_regularized_survival_simple.label: Direct age–cost normalization
age_and_cost_regularized_survival_simple.explanation: Replaces age and cost ranking with min–max normalization while retaining the 0.75 age and 0.25 cost weighting.

simplified_affine_profile_loss_gen34_7.label: Streamlined affine profile loss
simplified_affine_profile_loss_gen34_7.explanation: Retains affine fitting and direct residual evaluation with a bounded raw-RMSE penalty while removing compensated sums and specialized numerical handling.

novelty_weighted_quality_gated_niche_tou.label: Clone-only niche rescue
novelty_weighted_quality_gated_niche_tou.explanation: Drops sibling penalties, youth adjustments, and niche quality gating while retaining clone penalties and adaptive rare-niche rescue.

streamlined_niche_clone_tournament_gen43.label: Fixed-rate niche rescue
streamlined_niche_clone_tournament_gen43.explanation: Fixes rare-niche exploration at 10 percent and applies a single clone penalty once a better matching candidate is found.
